entries.6ac8ec2906a19521: It is a paperboard manufacturer, with the paperboard business accounting for most of its revenue. With its factory at the Okayama head office as its production base, it carries out region-rooted business activities centered on the Chugoku region.

entries.90e95762ae43fd36: Using waste paper as its raw material, it manufactures paperboard, including core board for corrugated board production and paper tube base paper used for winding cores, as well as packaging boxes and gift boxes (decorative corrugated board) for fresh produce, food, home appliances and other products.
entries.9e1a80d6a2dbbb77: The note to segment information states that revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥9,823 million for the paperboard business and ¥1,398 million for the decorative corrugated board business. entries.bf4872562d796d99: Its management philosophy is “to aim to become a 200-year company in a spirit of coexistence, in harmony with all stakeholders,” and it plans to continue region-rooted business activities centered on the Chugoku region, with its factory at the Okayama head office as its production base. Its priority issues are investment in human capital and reduction of environmental impact toward realizing sustainable corporate management, strengthening sales capabilities, energy saving, improving production efficiency and product development capability, and ensuring stable procurement of raw materials and reducing material procurement costs.

entries.e88d95d101f21e98: Its head office and factory are located in Minami-ku, Okayama City, and it is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. As of the fiscal year ended May 2026, it had 204 employees, and its only related company is Oji Holdings Corporation, which is classified as an other related company. The company does not prepare consolidated financial statements.
